title: Known genetic and pharmacological interventions on fin and body morphology parameters, for the Design Studio
note: Every entry is a manipulation that was SHOWN in an experiment, or is explicitly graded hypothesis where a paper only proposes it. All of it is proxy-species work, overwhelmingly zebrafish: no genetic manipulation has ever been done in a flying fish, so nothing here is a flying-fish result. A flying fish's wing is an enlarged pectoral fin. `usable_as_a_calibrated_knob` is true only where a paper gives BOTH a number and the stage it was measured at; most of this literature reports morphology in figure panels, so most entries carry the paper's words instead of a value and the Studio must not interpolate one. Stages fall into non-interpolable regimes (embryonic fin bud against reproductively mature adult): an effect measured in one does not transfer to the other. Pleiotropy is computed from the vetted map, not from the papers.
constraint: A draft genome of a flying fish EXISTS and is annotated, so the limit here is not missing genes. Xu et al. 2021 (Front Genet 12:695700, doi 10.3389/fgene.2021.695700) assembled the mirrorwing flyingfish Hirundichthys speculiger and predicted 23,611 protein-coding genes, of which 23,492 (99.5%) carry at least one database hit; that assembly is the one catalogued as GCA_018398805.1. What the flying fish lacks is PHENOTYPE and EXPRESSION records: that paper reports no RNA-seq and no transcriptome at all, no mutant, no kinetics and no regulatory network, and ZFIN-style expression and mutant-phenotype data exist only for zebrafish and, through Bgee, medaka. Every gene link in this map is therefore a PROXY-species record, zebrafish (Danio rerio) or medaka (Oryzias latipes, the same order Beloniformes as flying fish), and it is a proxy for that reason rather than because flying-fish genes are unknown. None of these links is a flying-fish measurement.

levels.coding: a change in the protein-coding sequence (allele, amino-acid substitution)
levels.cis-regulatory or expression: a change in where or how much the gene is expressed, without changing the protein
levels.TF dosage: a change in the amount of a transcription factor
levels.epigenetic: a change in chromatin state or silencing
levels.pharmacological: a drug or inhibitor, with its dose where the source gives one

grades.hypothesis: proposed in a paper, not shown there

summary.count_notes: with_measured_effect_size counts entries whose effect on their own named parameter is a number given by a source: hhip-uki-loss-fin-area (65%), hhip-uki-loss-fin-dorsoventral (50%), hhip-crispr-loss-caudal-hypural-number (two to five). All three are hhip. A fourth number, the reduction of coloboma occurrence from 71.3% to 26.3% by HPI-1, sits in rerea-HPI1-fin-no-change under effects_by_stage because it belongs to a different parameter than that entry's own. One entry, human-RERE-overexpression, has stage.reported false.

summary.note: No new fetches were made for this task; all quotes are re-read from bodies already saved under C:/Temp/genotype/agents/wing/ and logged in genotype/cache/calls_agent_wing.json (15 calls, 2 non-200). with_measured_effect_size counts rows whose effect_size.value is an actual number from the source; for pharmacological rows that number is the dose, not the effect magnitude, and the row says so.

wing.design_studio_notes: Effect magnitudes are the scarce resource here, not effect directions. Almost every morphological magnitude in this literature lives in a figure panel, so value is null in most rows and the words the paper used are kept in measured_as. The rows with both a real number and a real stage are listed in summary.rows_with_number_and_stage. Stages split cleanly into two regimes: embryonic pectoral fin BUD (32-56 hpf, Jiang 2024) and reproductively mature ADULT (>=3 months, Daane 2018 and Daane 2021; ZFIN stage Adult / ZFS:0000044). A slider must not interpolate between them: the bud measurement is an area standardized to eye size, the adult measurement is a length normalized to standard length.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin length
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source measures pectoral fin length for any gja1b allele. The only pectoral-relevant record is ZFIN's curated qualitative 'paired fin (ZFA:0005596) | shortened' for gja1b^dmh35/+ (PMID 28835471, full text publisher-blocked). Every quantitative cx43 fin measurement in the fetched record is on the caudal fin: Iovine/Hoptak-Solga/Sims/Bhattacharya/Seaver all amputate and measure the caudal fin, and Sims' and Seaver's measurements are on a single named caudal ray (V+3 and third-most dorsal respectively). Do not transfer a caudal segment number to the pectoral fin in the Studio without labelling it an assumption.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: fin area or span
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced genetic route through a connexin. Hoptak-Solga 2008 gives a whole-fin number ('half the length') but no area or span, and no fetched source measures fin area or span for any gja1b allele. The one source that claims a connexin/K+ manipulation moves 'fin size' is the Aramaki and Kondo preprint, abstract-only and unverifiable, and it does not define or quantify fin size.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: ray segment number
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Not measured as a count in any fetched source. The literature treats segment length and segment addition as separate mechanisms - Seaver 2025 states 'genetic mechanisms controlling segment length are independent of genetic mechanisms controlling segment addition' (citing Iovine et al. 2000) - but no fetched source reports a segment number for a cx43 allele. The nearest thing is Sims 2009's 'frequency of joint formation', which is reported as a segment-length distribution, not a count.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: ray branching / bifurcation
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No connexin route. The fetched route to branching is the shha/Smo basal-epidermis-to-pre-osteoblast interaction (Braunstein 2021, PMID 34038742) and the Fraser complex (fras1, preprint), neither of which is a connexin or a bidirectional lever.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: fin ray length in a flying fish or any non-model species
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No molecular or functional data for any connexin in Exocoetidae. Daane 2021's cx43 entry is a sequence-conservation call ('con', phyloP p = 0) and its gja5a entry is a convergent-substitution call; neither is a functional test, and gja5a is deliberately excluded here because it is not the fin-length connexin.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: cell-type-restricted segment-length control with a verified source
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Only the Aramaki and Kondo preprint restricts the manipulation to keratinocytes versus osteoblasts, and it is abstract-only. Every peer-reviewed intervention here is either germline (alleles) or systemic/local but not cell-type-restricted (hsp70 promoter, morpholino, GAP27 peptide).

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: fin area or span increased above wild type (the gliding-relevant direction)
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No intervention in this set increases any fin dimension beyond wild type. Every sourced effect is a decrease, or a partial rescue back toward wild type (prdm1a WT-mRNA +12% cleithrum, Prdm1a-dSET +38% scapulocoracoid area, both measured against the mutant, not against wild type). The only gain-of-function arms are the SHFM PRDM1 variants, which make the endoskeletal disk smaller, and sox9a/sox9b mRNA injection, which was scored on transcripts and not on fin morphology. For the Design Studio this means the TF-dosage and epigenetic levers in my set are enlargement-negative only: they can shrink a fin, not enlarge one.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: adult fin size, span or aspect ratio
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route. Every effect in this set is scored between 24 hpf and 13 dpf. The ezh2 maternal-zygotic mutant dies at 48 hpf and the rnf2 null at 4-5 dpf, i.e. before fin skeletal maturation, so these two levers can never report an adult fin parameter. No fish size or body length is given in any source fetched.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin lepidotrichium (ZFA:0001551) or actinotrichium (ZFA:0005545) number or length
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route in this set. No paper fetched reports a ray or actinotrichium measurement for any of these five genes; prdm1a's most distal measured structure is the fin fold and the endoskeletal disk.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin radial number or length (ZFA:0001586)
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route. Radials are not scored in any source fetched for prdm1a, sox9a, rnf2, ezh2 or hdac1.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin musculature (ZFA:0000563) mass or fibre type
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route. The only fin-muscle observation is incidental and qualitative: in rnf2 mutants 'a few MF20-positive cells, presumably pectoral fin muscle progenitors, were detected'. No muscle parameter was measured for any of the five genes.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: fin insertion position, fin angle or fin attachment on the body wall
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route. No source fetched reports a positional or angular fin parameter; all readouts are length, area, presence or ossification.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: fin enlargement by cis-regulatory change (enhancer edit)
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route at the level of a specific sequence. The only cis-regulatory element with a named motif in this set is the mouse Col2a1 intron-1 48-bp enhancer with three HMG-like sites bound by SOX9, which is mouse and not zebrafish, and no nucleotide sequence is given in the abstract fetched. The prdm1a CUT&RUN peaks give named Hox motifs for the whole peak set but no sequence, and no peak was functionally tested as an enhancer. Do not let the Design Studio offer an enhancer edit for these genes.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin length
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No source fetched in this run measures pectoral fin length (proximal-distal or longest-axis length) in any mutant of these five genes. Koudijs 2005 measured dorsoventral extent and area only, and explicitly found the anterior-posterior extent unchanged in hhip mutants. Tanaka 2024 reports an AP:PD shape change of the endoskeletal disc, not a fin length.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: fin ray (lepidotrichium, ZFA:0001551) number
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Tanaka 2024 states 'Zebrafish with hhip mutations are known to exhibit an increase in the number of fin rays and an enlarged pectoral fin primordia' but attributes this to Koudijs 2005 and van Eeden 1996 and does not measure it; neither the Koudijs full text nor the van Eeden abstract fetched here reports a fin ray count. The ZFIN row 'pectoral fin has extra parts of type' for hhip<sup>tc256d</sup> in the adult is the closest record but carries no count. No sourced route with a number.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: actinotrichium (ZFA:0005545) number or length
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source reports actinotrichia in any mutant of these five genes.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin musculature (ZFA:0000563), vasculature (ZFA:0005096), nerve (ZFA:0005436)
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source reports a fin muscle, vessel or nerve phenotype for these genes. Ochi 2006 shows hhip acts on slow versus fast muscle fate but in the trunk adaxial cells, not in the fin.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: apical ectodermal ridge (ZFA:0000085) and zone of polarizing activity (ZFA:0001451) extent
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source assays either node in a mutant of hhip, ptch1, disp1, cyp26a1 or rerea. The only evidence at these nodes is from shh (Neumann 1999) and fgf16 (Nomura 2006) experiments, so no gene in this set gives a sourced lever on them.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin area or radial number as a function of retinoic acid dose
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source gives a retinoic acid or RA-inhibitor concentration, so the RA axis has a sourced stage window (early gastrula through the six- to eight-somite stages) but no sourced dose. DEAB is not named in any fetched source and must not be displayed.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: radial number from a pharmacological intervention
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Cyclopamine rescue experiments in the only paper that performed them scored eye and ear, never the fin skeleton, and Tanaka 2024 performed no drug experiment. There is therefore no pharmacological route to a radial-number change, only a genetic one (hhip loss).

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: any cis-regulatory, TF-dosage or epigenetic intervention on a fin parameter
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Every fin-parameter intervention sourced here is coding (nonsense or frameshift), morpholino knockdown, or pharmacological. No enhancer deletion, no promoter variant and no epigenetic manipulation of these five genes with a fin readout was found. Tanaka 2024 notes that 'regulatory enhancers may also regulate the strength of Hedgehog signaling' but tested none. The CRISPR knock-in EGFP alleles are reporters, not regulatory interventions.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin area, span or aspect ratio
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Every adult measurement in all fetched sources for these three genes is a LENGTH (fin length, normalized to standard length) or a segment length. No paper measures pectoral fin area, span, chord or aspect ratio. The only area measurement anywhere in the set is Jiang 2024's pectoral fin BUD area at 32-56 hpf, standardized to eye or otic vesicle area, which is an embryonic bud, not the adult fin blade. A Design Studio slider for fin area or span therefore has no sourced genetic route in this gene set.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin ray number
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source reports a change in the NUMBER of pectoral fin rays (lepidotrichia) for kcnk5b, kcnh2a or slc43a2a. Perathoner 2014 reports segment number per ray (unchanged in alf, increased in lof and rapunzel), and ZFIN carries one contradictory 'lepidotrichium segment / increased amount' row, but ray count itself is never measured.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin insertion position, angle or orientation
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Nothing in the fetched set manipulates or measures where the pectoral fin attaches or at what angle. Daane 2021 notes the flying-fish caudal fin asymmetry aids above-water propulsion, but no gene in this set is tied to fin position.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin musculature or muscle mass
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No intervention in this gene set reports a muscle phenotype. Jiang 2024 notes the fin bud forms 'endochondral bone, musculature, and other tissues at the proximal base of the fin', but no muscle measurement follows from any kcnk5b, kcnh2a or slc43a2a manipulation. Guetg 2015 explicitly found no Lat4 protein in mouse skeletal muscle.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: body length (standard length) under kcnk5b or kcnh2a manipulation
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Only slc43a2a has a sourced body-length result (nr21: no statistically decreased body size). For kcnk5b, ZFIN carries a 'whole organism / shape abnormal' row and Perathoner 2014 compared 'fish of similar standard length' as a control rather than reporting SL as an outcome; Haffter 1996's abstract reports dominant body-length reductions for four unnamed mutations, not for alf. For kcnh2a, no body-length measurement was found at all.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: actinotrichia length or number in the pectoral fin
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: ZFIN carries one kcnk5b<ty86d/ty86d> row for CAUDAL fin actinotrichium increased length (PMID 28760345), whose abstract came back empty from PubMed efetch in this run, so nothing could be quoted. No actinotrichia measurement exists for the pectoral fin, nor for kcnh2a or slc43a2a.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: any parameter in an actual flying fish
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No gene in this set has ever been manipulated in a flying fish. The only flying-fish measurements in the fetched set are morphometric (static allometry of pectoral fins, hypocercal caudal fin, regular lepidotrichial segmentation) and sequence-level (lat4a F326L, kcnh2a-region and CNE acceleration). Every intervention above is zebrafish, or a mammalian ortholog in a heterologous system.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: epigenetic or TF-dosage routes
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No intervention of level 'epigenetic' or 'TF dosage' exists in this gene set. The closest thing to a transcription-factor route is the lof inversion recruiting the prrx1a regulatory region to the kcnh2a promoter, which is recorded above as cis-regulatory; Daane 2021 identifies no enhancer sequence or named motif for it, and separately flags accelerated evolution in the segmentation transcription factor evx1 without any functional test.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: ray segment length
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route through any of this agent's five genes. The only fetched route to this parameter is pathway-level and uses cx43 (sof b123) and smp, with unnamed pharmacological Wnt blockade, in REGENERATION (Bhattacharya 2018, PMID 30377172); and it carries no number and no stage. Nothing fetched reports segment length for lef1, rspo2, apc, wls or pbx4.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: ray branching or bifurcation (number of bifurcations, position of the first bifurcation)
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No sourced route at all, not even pathway-level. No fetched source links Wnt/beta-catenin or any of the five genes to ray bifurcation. The branching papers surfaced by search are Sonic hedgehog (PMID 34038742) and creb3l1 (PMIDs 39003620, 38964305), which were not fetched and are outside this agent's set.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: ray number (number of lepidotrichia per pectoral fin)
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Not measured in any fetched source. ZFIN gives 'decreased amount' qualities for caudal and anal fin lepidotrichia in rspo2, which is a curated ordinal term, not a count.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin length as a continuous measurement (mm, or % of body length)
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source gives a measured fin length for any of the five genes. Every fin-size result is either a ZFIN ordinal quality ('decreased length', 'decreased size', 'absent') or a qualitative figure description. The Studio cannot calibrate a length knob from this set.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: ray segment length or ray presence for apc, wls and pbx4
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Structurally impossible from the fetched evidence: apc fin rows stop at Larval:Protruding-mouth, wls mutants 'die by approximately 12 dpf' and even rescued ones do not reach adulthood, and pbx4 fin rows stop at Larval:Day 5. All three die or are scored before lepidotrichia form, so the effect_size values are null for that reason rather than for want of searching.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: fin fold size by Wnt LOSS in the embryo
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: Explicit negative result worth keeping: 30 microM IWR at 16 hpf and pulsed heat-shock dkk1 both lowered nuclear beta-catenin yet 'did not reveal any significant change in fin morphology' at 50 hpf (Nagendran 2015). The embryonic fin-fold-size knob is one-directional in the fetched evidence.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: pectoral fin regeneration for any of the five genes
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: All fetched regeneration work in this set is CAUDAL fin (Poss 2000, Thatcher 2008, Wehner 2014, Bhattacharya 2018). No fetched source tests lef1, rspo2, apc, wls or pbx4 in pectoral fin regeneration.

no_sourced_genetic_route.parameter: Wnt pathway position of pbx4
no_sourced_genetic_route.note: No fetched source of any kind links pbx4 to Wnt signalling. It is in this agent's set by ZFIN pectoral-fin ranking only and must not be rendered as a Wnt knob.

paralog_guards.rule: After the teleost genome duplication zebrafish often carries two paralogs, and this project found no cross-rescue for any of the pairs below. The Studio must never offer a route for one paralog on evidence gathered for the other, and must never present either as the flying-fish gene: orthology to a flying-fish gene is an assumption nowhere established here.

tbx5a.note: Teleost-specific whole-genome duplication left zebrafish with two TBX5 genes, tbx5a and tbx5b. Parrie 2013 (PMID 23441045): "Our phylogenetic analyses confirm tbx5b as a paralog that likely arose in the teleost-specific whole genome duplication ~270 MYA" and "injection of wild-type mRNA from one tbx5 paralog was not sufficient to cross-rescue phenotypes of the paralogous gene". Every tbx5a result below is tbx5a-specific and must NOT be transferred to tbx5b: the two have non-overlapping fin requirements (tbx5a = initiation, tbx5b = later outgrowth timing).

fgf10a.note: Zebrafish has two fgf10 genes from the whole-genome duplication. Yan 2015: "Due to whole genome duplication, the zebrafish has two fgf10 orthologs, fgf10a and fgf10b" and "While fgf10a has a role in development of the esophagus and swimbladder, we found in the present study that fgf10b had a complementary expression pattern in the liver, pancreas, and gut". Nothing in any fetched source places fgf10b in the pectoral fin or gives it a fin phenotype, so the fin role is fgf10a-specific and must not be generalised to fgf10b. The fin mutant allele daedalus (dae, tbvbo) is an fgf10a allele (Norton 2005).

shha.note: Fishes carry a shha paralog, shhb (tiggy winkle hedgehog), with a diverged cis-regulatory module. Hadzhiev 2007: "We demonstrate that the sonic hedgehog a ( shha ) paralogs sonic hedgehog b ( tiggy winkle hedgehog ; shhb ) genes of fishes have a modified ar-C enhancer, which specifies a diverged function at the embryonic midline" and "Altering and exchanging motifs between paralog enhancers resulted in reversal of enhancer specificity in the floor plate and notochord". No fetched source places shhb in the pectoral fin bud or gives it a fin phenotype, and the diverged enhancer is direct evidence that paralog expression domains are partitioned - so no shha fin result may be transferred to shhb. The fin mutant allele sonic you (syu, tq252) is a shha allele.

pax7a.note: teleost-duplication paralogs; evidence on one is not evidence for the other

paralog_guards.tbx5a_tbx5b_specifically: Asked for by the hub. tbx5a is the pectoral fin initiation gene whose null never develops a fin bud, and it also builds the heart (its mutant is 'heartstrings'), so it is the worst pleiotropy case in the set. tbx5b has ZERO experimental molecular-function evidence (its GO annotation is inferred by ancestry only) and no sub-organ phenotype. Neither gene has an intervention entry in this file yet, because no interventions extraction has been run for them; until one is, the Studio has no sourced tbx5 route of any kind and must offer none.

interventions.side_effects: 'Embryos were staged throughout the first four days of development to ensure that there was no developmental delay or unassociated pathologies due to the mRNA overexpression.' In a WT background, overexpression of the SHFM variants p.C239Lfs*32 and p.T819A significantly shortened the endoskeletal disk (P=0.0135 and P=0.0280).
interventions.reversibility: This IS the rescue arm: WT hPRDM1 partially rescued; p.C239Lfs*32, p.T524R and p.T819A failed to rescue, and p.T819A made the endoskeletal disk worse. Dose/function-specific lever: the rescue depends on an intact proline/serine-rich domain and an intact DNA-binding zinc finger domain.
interventions.fin_autonomous: not established - mRNA was injected at the single-cell stage, so expression is global; only the readout is fin-specific

sources.quote: In prdm1a -/- mutants, injection of WT hPRDM1 partially rescued the pectoral fin defects and the fins more closely resembled those of uninjected WT (Fig. 3A-C), particularly the length of the cleithrum (12% increase), endoskeletal disk (5.5%), and fin fold (6%)
In contrast, overexpression of the three SHFM variants failed to rescue the elements of the pectoral fin (Fig. 3D-F).
(C-F) prdm1a -/- mutants were injected with (C) WT hPRDM1 ( n =10), (D) hPRDM1 (p.C239Lfs*32) ( n =10), (E) hPRDM1 (p.T524R) ( n =8) or (F) hPRDM1 (p.T819A) mRNA ( n =7).

sources.quote: To determine the impacts of overexpression exogenous Xl-kcna5 , Tg + and Tg - fins at 72 hpa were treated for systemic heat shock at 37C for one hour. Then, at 7 days post amputation (dpa) (4 days post heat shock), fins were stained with the vital dye calcein ( Du et al., 2001 ) and segment length and regenerate length were measured. Interestingly, we observed a significant increase in segment length in Tg + HS + compared to the Tg - HS + siblings ( Fig. 2 A , C , E ). However, there was no accompanying change in overall regenerate length ( Fig 2 A , B , D ).

Interestingly, we found that segment length was only modestly longer in the Tg + HS + sof b123 fish compared with Tg - HS + sof b123 siblings ( Fig. 5 A , C , E ). Because the segment length phenotype is not fully rescued to WT levels, the impacts of Xl-Kcna5 overexpression are attenuated by less Cx43-GJIC. These findings suggest that bioelectricity induced by overexpression of Xl-Kcna5 requires wild-type levels of Cx43-GJIC in order to enhance segment length.

We used an equal number of transgenic positive kcna5 fish and transgene negative sibling male and female fish aged between 6- and 18-months age-matched within each experiment. Caudal fin amputations were performed using 0.1% MS222 anesthesia solution. ... All other amputations were performed at the 50% level. ... Measurement was taken on the third-most dorsal ray of the caudal fin as previously established ( Iovine and Johnson, 2000 ). Segments were measured as the distance from the first joint formed distal of the amputation plane to the second joint.

We observed no significant difference in the number of mitotic cells between Tg - HS + and Tg + HS + at either time point ( Fig 3 ). Thus, the temporal overexpression of Xl-kcna5 is sufficient for changes in gene expression that affect segment length but not sufficient for changes in cell proliferation.

Xl-Kcna5 is 78% identical to zebrafish Kcna5 at the amino acid level, and 75% identical at the nucleotide level. We selected a heterologous potassium channel to support the concept that intracellular potassium concentration, rather than a specific gene product, is the relevant contributor.

sources.quote: The molecular identification of the fin length mutant short fin (sof), which causes defects in the length of bony fin ray segments, may provide insights regarding the regulation of bone growth. In this report, we demonstrate that the sof phenotype is caused by mutations in the connexin43 (cx43) gene. This conclusion is supported by genetic mapping, reduced expression of cx43 in the original sof allele (sofb123), identification of missense mutations in three ENU-induced alleles, and by demonstration of partially abrogated cx43 function in sofb123 embryos.

Three independently generated cx43 alleles exhibit short segments of variable sizes, suggesting that gap junctional intercellular communication may regulate bone growth. Dye coupling assays showed that all alleles are capable of forming gap junction channels. However, ionic coupling assays revealed allele-specific differences in coupling efficiency and gating. For instance, oocyte pairs expressing the weakest allele exhibited much higher levels of coupling than either of the strong alleles. Therefore, measurable differences in Cx43 function may be correlated with the severity of defects in bone length.
Indeed, missense alleles exhibiting high or low levels of gap junctional communication reveal a correlation between defects in direct cell-cell communication, cell proliferation, and segment length.

sources.quote: In zebrafish, mutations in the gap junction gene connexin43 lead to short bony fin ray segments that give rise to the short fin phenotype. The sof(b123) mutant exhibits fins that are half the length of wild-type fins and have reduced levels of cx43 mRNA.

The molecular identification of the fin length mutant short fin (sof), which causes defects in the length of bony fin ray segments, may provide insights regarding the regulation of bone growth. In this report, we demonstrate that the sof phenotype is caused by mutations in the connexin43 (cx43) gene. This conclusion is supported by genetic mapping, reduced expression of cx43 in the original sof allele (sofb123), identification of missense mutations in three ENU-induced alleles, and by demonstration of partially abrogated cx43 function in sofb123 embryos.

First, we found that cx43 expression is 15-20-fold lower in sof b123 fins, consistent with our previous report showing that Cx43 protein levels are reduced in sof b123 animals ( Hoptak-Solga et al., 2008 ). When examining alf dty86 fins we found that cx43 levels are consistently 1.5-2-fold higher than wild-type.

Finally, targeted gene knockdown of cx43 in adult regenerating fins recapitulates the sof(b123) phenotype, revealing that the loss of Cx43 is sufficient to reduce both cell proliferation and segment length.

Indeed, knockdown of cx43 in alf dty86 mutant fins rescues joint formation. Together, these data reveal a correlation between the level of Cx43 expression in the fin ray mesenchyme and the location of joints.

Wild-type segments averaged 290.7 +/- 32.7 um across the fin ray while the alf dty86 segments averaged 609.5 +/- 318.9 um. Thus, alf dty86 segments were on average twice as long as wild type segments while also exhibiting a very broad deviation from the mean ( Figure 4B ).
